name: がーべら(gerbera)
description: illustration◆ご依頼はDMかメールにてお気軽にご連絡ください ご依頼についてはこちら▷ ▷https://lit.link/gerbera152 ◆skeb→ http://skeb.jp/@Gerbera152

works.body:
Nice to meet you!

My name is Hane, and I am active on twitch!

Hinano's swimsuit illustration was really cute, so I'd like you to draw my character in a swimsuit ♡!

I have black bobbed hair and blue eyes!
She is petite, about 150cm tall, and I would like to leave the rest up to you!

I'd love to ask Gabella @ Work Wanted to do it for me, is it possible? 🌸

It is nice to meet you.
I would like to make this request because I have seen your wonderful drawings and I would like to commission you to draw a picture for me.

I would like to request an illustration of Emma Aizawa and Luna Shiomiya in a school parody style.
I would like them to wear black sailor uniforms. I will leave the situation, composition, pose, etc. up to you.
It would be great if the two of them can be friendly with each other.
Luna Shiimiya's hairstyle should be the same as in the Buisupopu website! We would like her hairstyle to be the same as the initial image shown on the website of Buisupo! (https://vspo.jp/member/)

The use of this image is for icons and headers on X (formerly twitter), Discord, etc., and as wallpaper on smartphones.
Also, since we would like to use it as a wallpaper for smartphones, please make it a portrait size if possible.

We are very sorry that the content of this request is so vague, but we appreciate your cooperation.

改めまして、manjimanです。
使用用途は PCケースへの印刷の予定なのですが、兎咲ミミさん、一ノ瀬うるはさんを前がーべらさが描かれていた一ノ瀬うるはさんとラトナプティさんのイラストのような構図で描いて頂けますと幸いです。できれば花芽なずなさんもそのイラストに追加して頂きたいのですが、値段的に厳しそうであればお手数ですが再送依頼をして頂けますとありがたく存じます。

Hello Mr. Gabela, my name is Yako Furunaka.
I am Yako Furunaka, and I would like to ask you to do an illustration for us.
I would like to request your illustration! I would like to request your illustration.

Usage】Twitter, YouTube thumbnails, etc.
Please refer to the document URL in Google Drive.
Twitter ID : @konaka_85

She is a neutral looking but vivacious and cheerful sister.

The pose is up to the artist, but we would appreciate it if you could draw her in a pose where her head is not completely obscured, as we would like to use her as a thumbnail.

We apologize for the inconvenience, but we would appreciate your consideration!

Once again, I am Tenshuhaku.
Thank you very much for your wonderful appeal ......!
I am contacting you to ask you to create an illustration for me to use in my future activities.
The composition and other details are completely up to you! If possible, I would like to receive a PSD file or a transparent background. I look forward to your consideration...!
